question: Chami Murmu, an Indian environmental activist, was awarded the Padma Shri in 2024 for her work in founding the _____, which has planted over 3 million trees in Jharkhand.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sahayogi Mahila Bagraisai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chami Murmu is an Indian environmental activist known for her significant contributions to environmental conservation.
 
• She founded the organization **Sahayogi Mahila Bagraisai**, which focuses on tree plantation and environmental sustainability.
 
• Under her leadership, the organization has planted over 3 million trees in the state of Jharkhand.
 
• In recognition of her efforts, she was awarded the Padma Shri in 2024, one of India's highest civilian honors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri Award**

 
 
• It is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India.
 
• It is awarded to individuals for distinguished contributions in various fields including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• The award is announced annually on Republic Day.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Activism in India**
 
 
• India has a rich history of environmental activism, addressing issues such as deforestation, pollution, and wildlife conservation.
 
• Notable environmental movements include the Chipko Movement and the Narmada Bachao Andolan.
 
 
 
• **Tree Plantation Initiatives**
 
 
• Tree plantation is a crucial activity in combating climate change and promoting biodiversity.
 
• Various NGOs and government schemes in India focus on large-scale tree plantation drives.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand**
 
 
• Jharkhand is a state in eastern India known for its diverse flora and fauna.
 
• It is rich in mineral resources and has significant forest cover.
